verses.sanskrit:
वैशम्पायन उवाच।
              विद्राव्य तु रणे सर्वानसुरान्पुरुषोत्तमः। मुमोच तत्र बद्धांस्तान्पुरन्दरमुखान्सुरान्॥१॥
ततः प्रकृतिमापन्नाः सर्वे देवगणास्तथा। पुरन्दरं पुरस्कृत्य नारायणमुपस्थिताः॥२॥
verses.english: “O brahman, in the purANA-s the sages have described the incarnations of विष्णु of unlimited energy... we have heard from them that the Lord incarnated himself as a boar. But we do not know his history fully... what accomplishments he has; what are his objectives, conduct and prowess, and what kind of god he is when he assumed this form of a boar... and what he was doing before it...

verses.sanskrit:
देवा ऊचुः।
              त्वत्प्रसादेन भगवंस्तव बाहुबलेन च। जिवमोऽद्य महाबाहो निष्क्रान्ताश्चान्तकाननात्॥३॥
verses.english: How, in the days of yore, did he sip the subterranean lava-like oceanic oblation assuming the form of a submarine-fire, called सम्वर्तक-अग्नि...

verses.sanskrit: त्वच्छासनाद्धि भगवन्किं कुर्वन्त्यदितेः सुताः। इच्छामः पादशुश्रूषां तव कर्तुं सनातन॥४॥
verses.english: Who devised आहवनीय fireplaces and यज्ञ-वेदि-स् - the sacrificial altar; made material like कुश – holy grass; स्रुव – a ladle, long spoon to pour oblations into fire; ध्रुव – a beaker-like mug; प्रोक्शण पात्राणि –vessels with which other vessels can be anointed; material for आवभृथ baths – finishing baths of rituals...

verses.sanskrit:
वैशम्पायन उवाच।
              तच्छ्रुत्वा वचनं तेषां पुण्डरीकनिभेक्षणः। उवाच वचनं देवान्मुदा युक्तो हतद्विषः॥५॥
verses.english: He, who obtained ambrosia from the northerly fringe, i.e., at heavenward fringe, of Milk Ocean...; who on devising a kind of haze – तिमिरम् = योग माय – reposes eternally on the billows of that Milk Ocean... who is he...

verses.sanskrit:
श्रीभगवानुवाच।
              यो यस्य भवतो लोको मयैव विहितः पुरा। पाल्यतां स तु यज्ञेन नियोगश्च क्वचित्क्वचित्॥६॥
ऐश्वर्यं प्रतिपन्नः स्वं क्रतुभागपुरस्कृतम्। मयैव पूर्वं निर्दिष्टो नियोगः प्रतिपाल्यताम्॥७॥
verses.english: It will be apt of you to tell me in detail about the history of his manifestations and their nature...

verses.sanskrit: शक्रं चोवाच भगवान्वचनं दुन्दुभिस्वनः। इदं यथावत्कर्तव्यं सत्सु चासत्सु च त्वया॥८॥
verses.english: You say that he will always be in the thick of immortals and pious souls, then why he stepped out of such a realm of gods and supersouls, and stepped into the mortal world... you say that he is the soul-a-priori, either of mortals or of gods – दिव्य आत्मा – and even the mortal world has emanated from him, then why he defrocked his celestial nature into a trifling mortal being... you say that he is the single unpernicious wheelsman of the universe, -अनामय पर ब्रह्म - then why did he make up his mind to wheelspin this pernicious world from within – आमय भूयिष्ट प्रपन्चम् –that too on taking a pernicious birth...

verses.sanskrit: गच्छन्तु तपसा स्वर्गं मुनयः शंसितव्रताः। तव लोकं सुरश्रेष्ठ सर्वकामदुघं सदा। यायजूकाश्च ये केचिद्ब्राह्मणाः क्षत्रिया विशः॥९॥
verses.english: You say that he implicitly moves the universe composed of कला-काष्टा-मुहुर्ता-s, seconds, minutes, hours etc time divisions aggregating to युग-मन्वन्तर-परार्था-s, eras, grand-eras etc... Then, how did he get into this world only to circuit the ranch moving the cows from dawn to dusk...

verses.sanskrit: तेषां कामदुघा लोकाः स्वर्गमादिमनोहराः। यज्ञैरिष्ट्वा यायजूकाः फलं ते प्राप्नुवन्तु च॥१०॥
verses.english: He, whose quiddity is manifest in the sky inclusive of directions and inter-directions, air, water, fire, or earth, because earth is also वि+भा+वसु – i.e. – विशेषेण भाति= विभा, ज्योतिः; वसुमति - प्ऱिथ्वी; and the light with which sun and moon are aglow- चन्द्र सूर्य प्रथानम् ज्योतिः; or मनो-ज्योथि, चक्शुर् ज्योथि - illuminist of the eye, or heart, because he is the destroyer of क्षणद = night, say darkness, that too without a ripple in his attitude - योगि-ईश = निर्विकल्प... who is this योगीश...

verses.sanskrit: भावः सद्धर्मशीलानामभावः पापकर्मणाम्। सन्तः स्वर्गजितः सन्तु सर्वाश्रमनिवासिनः॥११॥
verses.english: He is said to be devouring entire universe at the end of era, himself becoming a sheet of primordial waters – जल स्वरूप; and how that antediluvian soul - पुराण-आत्मा - with a nebulous manifestation - दृश्य अदृश्य आत्मा- extolled in legends upheaved the submersed earth in the very primordial waters on the points of his tusks when he donned a sacramental-boar, यज्ञ-वराह मूर्ति, incarnation...

verses.sanskrit: सत्यशूरा रणे शूरा दानशूराश्च ये नराः। ते नराः स्वर्गमश्नन्तु सदा ये चानसूयवः॥१२॥
verses.english: You say that he implicitly moves the universe composed of कला-काष्टा-मुहुर्ता-s, seconds, minutes, hours etc time divisions aggregating to युग-मन्वन्तर-परार्था-s, eras, grand-eras etc... Then, how did he get into this world only to circuit the ranch moving the cows from dawn to dusk...

verses.sanskrit: अश्रद्दधानाः पुरुषाः कामिनोऽर्थपराः शठाः। अब्रह्मण्या नास्तिकाश्च नरकं यान्तु मानवाः॥१३॥
verses.english: How he assumed the form of a two-in-one personality, man-lion, and how he eliminated the prime दैत्य, namely the highly energetic हिरण्यकशिपु॥।

verses.sanskrit: एतावत्क्रियतां वाक्यं मयोक्तं त्रिदशेश्वराः। ततो मयि स्थिते सर्वान्बाधिष्यन्ते न चारयः॥१४॥
verses.english: How, in the days of yore, did he sip the subterranean lava-like oceanic oblation assuming the form of a submarine-fire, called सम्वर्तक-अग्नि...

verses.sanskrit: इत्युक्त्वान्तर्हितो देवः शङ्कचक्रगदाधरः। देवतानां च सर्वेषामभवद्विस्मयो महान्॥१५॥
verses.english: In this way that Supreme Person said to have created the world in primeval times... then, who is he... then again, how that imperishable विष्णु has come by manhood in this perishable world...

verses.sanskrit: एतदत्यद्भुतं दृष्ट्वा वाराहचरितं सुराः। नमस्कृत्य वराहाय नाकपृष्ठमितो गताः॥१६॥
verses.english: He is anywise said to be the lord of universe, because he is involved in those that are involved the cycle of birth and death, and mankind in particular, because he takes delight in mankind alone, because he is experienceable only to mankind through their sense faculties... who is he...

verses.sanskrit: ततः स्वान्याधिपत्यानि प्रतिपन्नानि दैवतैः। सर्वलोकाधिपत्ये च प्रतिष्ठां वासवो गताः॥१७॥
verses.english: It is said that air has emerged from space; and प्राण, the vital-spirit, from that air; and the devourer of oblations, more specifically the firegod, has come from that vital-spirit; and this firegod, devourer of oblations, is the life-spirit of gods, whereas मधु-सूदन is the life-spirit of that firegod, हुत-अशन...

verses.sanskrit: विमुक्ता दानवगणैः प्रकृतिं धरणी गता। स्थैर्यहेतोर्धरण्यास्तु ज्ञात्वा चागस्कृतान्गिरीन्॥१८॥
verses.english: How he assumed the form of a two-in-one personality, man-lion, and how he eliminated the prime दैत्य, namely the highly energetic हिरण्यकशिपु॥।

verses.sanskrit: स्वेषु स्थानेषु संस्थाप्य पर्वतानां पुरन्दरः। चिच्छेद भगवान्पक्षान्वज्रेण शतपर्वणा॥१९॥
verses.english: He, who obtained ambrosia from the northerly fringe, i.e., at heavenward fringe, of Milk Ocean...; who on devising a kind of haze – तिमिरम् = योग माय – reposes eternally on the billows of that Milk Ocean... who is he...

verses.sanskrit: सर्वेषामेव पक्षा वै छिन्नाः शक्रेण धीमता। एकः सपक्षो मैनकः सुरैस्तत्समयः कृतः॥२०॥
verses.english: Who in various eras will be with umpteen cogitations, umpteen watches, umpteen transits, and who bestows everything in a number of ways, whereby he is called a god...
verses.bhavadeepa: चिच्छेद पूर्वं दानवोद्योगकरत्वेन सापराधानां पक्षान् चिच्छेद॥१९॥

verses.sanskrit: एष नारायणस्यायं प्रादुर्भावो महात्मनः। वाराह इति विप्रेन्द्रैः पुराणे परिकीर्तितः॥२१॥
verses.english: He who has created the triad of worlds by his incessant action; who has created all the hosts of beings, yet who is the inferential soul of all beings...
verses.bhavadeepa: सुरैः समयः मैनाकरक्षायै कृतः यथा समुद्रे स्थितस्य ते न पक्षच्छेदो भवितेति॥२०॥

verses.sanskrit: कृष्णद्वैपायनमतं नानाश्रुतिसमाहितम्। नाशुचेर्न कृतघ्नाय न नृशंसाय कीर्तयेत्॥२२॥
verses.english: Who is he at whose hand the demon tAraka-asura met his end...

verses.sanskrit: न क्षुद्राय न नीचाय न गुरुद्वेषकारिणे। नाशिष्याय तथा राजन्न कृतघ्नाय चैव हि॥२३॥
verses.english: Who devised आहवनीय fireplaces and यज्ञ-वेदि-स् - the sacrificial altar; made material like कुश – holy grass; स्रुव – a ladle, long spoon to pour oblations into fire; ध्रुव – a beaker-like mug; प्रोक्शण पात्राणि –vessels with which other vessels can be anointed; material for आवभृथ baths – finishing baths of rituals...

verses.sanskrit: आयुष्कामैर्यशः कामैर्महीकामैश्च मानवैः। जयैषिभिश्च श्रोतव्यो देवानामेष वै जयः॥२४॥
verses.english: He who created the three sorts of ambrosial life principle sudhA - in the triad of worlds; who made the brAhmaNa-s as the officiators to oblate हव्या-s – for gods, and कव्या-s - for manes, and who simultaneously made gods and ancestors as the receivers of those offerings...

verses.sanskrit: पुराणवेदसम्बद्धः शिवः स्वस्त्ययनो महन्। पावनः सर्वसत्त्वानां तत्कालविजयप्रदः॥२५॥
verses.english: He, whom the consummate ascetic lady अदिति has begotten, and he, who on coming into being from lady अदिति is said to have saved इन्द्र, who by then is beset by hosts of demons... who is he...

verses.sanskrit: एष कौरव्य तत्त्वेन कथितस्त्वनुपूर्वशः। वाराहस्य नृपश्रेष्ठ प्रादुर्भावो महात्मनः॥२६॥
verses.english: Who covered the triad of worlds in triple strides in his त्रि-विक्रम incarnation, and duly posited इन्द्र in heaven, emperor बलि in netherworld, and demons in briny deep...

verses.sanskrit: ये यजन्ति मखैः पुण्यैर्दैवतानि पितॄनपि। आत्मानमात्मना नित्यं विष्णुमेव जयन्ति ते॥२७॥
verses.english: He who has systematized the time right from an instant to the unscalable time factor as क्षणा, लव, काष्ठ, कल, त्रि-काल, मुहूर्त, तिथि, पक्ष, मास, ऋतु, संवत्सर; and then tenets like काल-yoga, threefold validations, namely श्रुति, स्मृ, शिष्टाचार-s; and the threesome functions of नित्य, नैमित्तिक, काम्य कर्मा-s undertaking which the lifespan – आयु, physiques – क्षेत्राणि, development – उपचय, वृद्धि, characteristics – लक्षणं, physical bearing - रूप-सौष्ठवम्, of all the mobile and sessile beings will function; and who created the threesome social system - त्रय वर्णा-s - ब्रह्म, क्शत्रिय, वैश्य, शूद्रा-s implied; triad of worlds - भू, भुवः, सुवः; triplex education – ऱिक्, यजुर्, अथर्व, साम implied; trinity of sacred fires – दक्शिनात्य, आहवनीय, गार्हपत्य अग्नि-s; triune of time - भूत, भविष्यत्, वर्तमान – all in one factor called the time; triple action types – gentle, aggressive, moronic actions according to सत्त्व, रजस्, तमो गुणा-s; triple cravings – पुत्रैषण, वित्तैषण, लोकै षण - and threesome subtle factors...

verses.sanskrit: लोकायनाय त्रिदशायनाय ब्राह्मायनायात्मभवायनाय। नारायणायात्महितायनाय महवराहाय नमस्कुरुष्व॥२८॥
verses.english: He who has created the triad of worlds by his incessant action; who has created all the hosts of beings, yet who is the inferential soul of all beings...
